blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines kept University of the East searching for its first win in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament after a 91-81 win at UST’s Quadricentennial Pavilion on Saturday. The Fighting Maroons hiked their winning streak to three, ending the first round of eliminations with a 5-2 record. The Red Warriors, meanwhile, remained without a victory this season after seven games.
